title: Fonix scoped pre-1.0 candidate evidence and approval bundle
description: A closed inventory of exact evidence references and independently produced detached approvals for one scoped candidate. Missing exact records are permitted only so validation can enumerate them; no field in this document asserts readiness or authorizes publication.

candidateSubjectSha256.$comment: The validator recomputes this digest from canonical JSON of candidateStatement.

claimBoundary.const: This bundle binds candidate evidence and detached approval artifacts only. It does not itself establish readiness, verify signatures, authorize publication or distribution, or weaken the global five-platform release gate.

approvalStatement.$comment: Detached approval statement bytes are parsed and compared with their bundle entry by the validator.

signatureVerificationReceipt.$comment: This receipt is an externally produced trust input; this schema does not perform cryptographic verification.
